The upper photograph is darker and grainier than the two lower photographs; the lower right view shows a metallic restoration among the posterior teeth. No printed text, numbers, scale bars, patient names, dates or device text are visible; no faces or external anatomy are visible. Gingival swelling grade, hemorrhage and edema are not judged from pixels; they are caption claims.

visual.general_description: Two stacked line charts, (A) PCR and GI and (B) tumor markers, against course of chemotherapy 11 to 21.
visual.detailed_description: Panel (A) plots PCR (left axis, %) and GI (right axis) and panel (B) plots CEA (left axis, ng/mL) with CA19-9 and CA125 (right axis, U/mL) against course of chemotherapy 11 to 21. PCR and GI fall overall, CEA dips and then rises in later courses, CA19-9 is relatively flat and CA125 low and flat. No values are read from the points.

panels.general_description: Line chart of PCR and GI against course of chemotherapy.
panels.detailed_description: Panel (A) is a line chart with printed panel letter (A), a left axis labeled PCR (%) with ticks 0, 50 and 100, a right axis labeled GI with ticks 0, 1.0, 2.0 and 3.0, and an x axis labeled Course of chemotherapy with ticks 11 through 21 (an unlabelled wider gap lies between ticks 17 and 18). A legend lists open circles for PCR and closed circles for GI. The PCR series (solid line) starts at its highest point at the first tick, falls steeply over the first courses, fluctuates, reaches its lowest point in the later courses and then rises again toward the end. The GI series (dotted line) falls gradually and steadily with a flat stretch between ticks 18 and 20. Both series extend slightly past tick 21. No data labels, patient names, dates or device text are printed. Values are not read from the points.
